_notes: PG decisions ledger. Entries accumulate as reconcile surfaces novel items and the user resolves each to a model row. After the 2026-04-25 variant collapse, model_sheet is informational only (sheet_group derivation: BS / IS / CF). The actual sheet routed to at write time comes from SHEET_NAME[(filing_type, statement_type)] in reconcile, so a single entry serves both 10-K and 10-Q runs.

mappings.filing_term_normalized: income loss including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest
mappings.note: PG's iXBRL tags Earnings Before Income Taxes with us-gaap:IncomeLossIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest — a non-standard use; FASB taxonomy reserves this concept for post-tax NI Including NCI. Override routes the concept to Pre-Tax Income for PG on both 10-K and 10-Q filings. Generic library alias for this concept stays valid for filers tagging it correctly. Long-term fix: parse iXBRL label linkbase to recover the visual label per concept.

new_rows.note: Contra-equity reserve offsetting PG's guarantee of the ESOP trust's debt. Presented as a negative number reducing TSE on the filing. ~$637M at Q2 FY2026, declining as ESOP amortizes. Company-specific (legacy leveraged ESOP from 1989) — not promoted to generic library. Applies to both 10-K and 10-Q filings.
